Server options must be set before booting. Moving them outside `waitForBoot`:


```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server BEFORE booting (PHJ convolution is CPU-intensive)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 12;
s.options.blockSize = 512; // Larger block size reduces CPU load
s.options.hardwareBufferSize = 512;
s.boot;
	
s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder (use smaller kernel size to reduce CPU load) and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ(512, s); // Use 512 instead of default (usually 2048)
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) and B-format for metering (8-11: W,X,Y,Z)
			Out.ar(0, dec ++ bfmt);
		}).add;

		s.sync;

	// Load test file automatically (4-channel UHJ: L, R, T=0, Q=0)
	buf = Buffer.read(s, "/home/michael-uwins/Dropbox/PhD/Practical Work/The Alan Parsons Project/Stereotomy/StereotomyUPHJ.wav");
	s.sync;

	// UI
	win = Window("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test", Rect(80, 80, 780, 380), false).front;
	win.view.background = Color.black;
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 10, 200, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test");
	fileLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(10, 35, 380, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("StereotomyUPHJ.wav (4-ch UHJ)");
	playBtn = Button(win, Rect(10, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["PLAY", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({
		if(buf.notNil && buf.numFrames > 0) {
			if(player.notNil) { player.free };
			player = Synth(\foa_512_test, [
				\buffer, buf,
				\muteWBus, muteBusses[0].index,
				\muteXBus, muteBusses[1].index,
				\muteYBus, muteBusses[2].index,
				\muteZBus, muteBusses[3].index
			]);
			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts
			{
				if(meter.notNil) { meter.remove };
				if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
				meter = ServerMeter2View.new(s, meterContainer, 0@0, 0, 8); // 0 inputs, 8 outputs (decoded)
				// Create custom B-format meter (monitors buses 8-11)
				bfmtMeter = ~createBFmtMeter.value(s, bfmtMeterContainer);
			}.defer(0.1);
		};
	});
	stopBtn = Button(win, Rect(100, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["STOP", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({ if(player.notNil) { player.free } });
	
	// B-format mute buttons
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 95, 100, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("B-format mutes:");
	muteBtns = Array.fill(4, { |i|
		var x = 10 + (i * 60);
		var label = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"][i];
		StaticText(win, Rect(x, 115, 20, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_(label);
		Button(win, Rect(x, 135, 50, 20))
			.states_([["MUTE", Color.black, Color.cyan], ["MUTE", Color.cyan, Color.black]])
			.action_({ |btn| muteBusses[i].set(btn.value) });
	});
	
	// Z amplitude monitor (to verify encoder fix)
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");
	
	// Monitor Z amplitude
	OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor, { |msg|
		var amp = msg[3];
		{
			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// Create monitoring synth for buses 8-11 (B-format channels)
		monitorSynth = SynthDef(\bfmtMonitor, {
			var bfmt = In.ar(8, 4); // Read from buses 8-11
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, "/bfmtLevels");
			Out.ar(0, 0); // Silent output
		}).play(server, nil, \addToTail);
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { monitorSynth.free; OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

Updated the script to:
1. Set server options before booting (required)
2. Use block size 512 to reduce CPU load
3. Use PHJ kernel size 512 (instead of default 2048) to reduce convolution complexity

PHJ convolution is CPU-intensive. If it still crashes, try:
- Using kernel size 256 (smaller)
- Increasing block size to 1024
- Reducing the number of output channels

Try running it again. If it still fails, we can reduce the kernel size further or optimize the convolution.

```supercollider
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// Create monitoring synth for buses 8-11 (B-format channels)
		monitorSynth = SynthDef(\bfmtMonitor, {
			var bfmt = In.ar(8, 4); // Read from buses 8-11
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, "/bfmtLevels");
			Out.ar(0, 0); // Silent output
		}).play(server, nil, \addToTail);
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { monitorSynth.free; OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 12 output channels (8 for decoded + 4 for B-format metering)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 12;

s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) and B-format for metering (8-11: W,X,Y,Z)
			Out.ar(0, dec ++ bfmt);
		}).add;

		s.sync;

	// Load test file automatically (4-channel UHJ: L, R, T=0, Q=0)
	buf = Buffer.read(s, "/home/michael-uwins/Dropbox/PhD/Practical Work/The Alan Parsons Project/Stereotomy/StereotomyUPHJ.wav");
	s.sync;

	// UI
	win = Window("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test", Rect(80, 80, 780, 380), false).front;
	win.view.background = Color.black;
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 10, 200, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test");
	fileLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(10, 35, 380, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("StereotomyUPHJ.wav (4-ch UHJ)");
	playBtn = Button(win, Rect(10, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["PLAY", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({
		if(buf.notNil && buf.numFrames > 0) {
			if(player.notNil) { player.free };
			player = Synth(\foa_512_test, [
				\buffer, buf,
				\muteWBus, muteBusses[0].index,
				\muteXBus, muteBusses[1].index,
				\muteYBus, muteBusses[2].index,
				\muteZBus, muteBusses[3].index
			]);
			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts
			{
				if(meter.notNil) { meter.remove };
				if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
				meter = ServerMeter2View.new(s, meterContainer, 0@0, 0, 8); // 0 inputs, 8 outputs (decoded)
				// Create custom B-format meter (monitors buses 8-11)
				bfmtMeter = ~createBFmtMeter.value(s, bfmtMeterContainer);
			}.defer(0.1);
		};
	});
	stopBtn = Button(win, Rect(100, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["STOP", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({ if(player.notNil) { player.free } });
	
	// B-format mute buttons
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 95, 100, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("B-format mutes:");
	muteBtns = Array.fill(4, { |i|
		var x = 10 + (i * 60);
		var label = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"][i];
		StaticText(win, Rect(x, 115, 20, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_(label);
		Button(win, Rect(x, 135, 50, 20))
			.states_([["MUTE", Color.black, Color.cyan], ["MUTE", Color.cyan, Color.black]])
			.action_({ |btn| muteBusses[i].set(btn.value) });
	});
	
	// Z amplitude monitor (to verify encoder fix)
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");
	
	// Monitor Z amplitude
	OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor, { |msg|
		var amp = msg[3];
		{
			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)

				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// Create monitoring synth for buses 8-11 (B-format channels)
		monitorSynth = SynthDef(\bfmtMonitor, {
			var bfmt = In.ar(8, 4); // Read from buses 8-11
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, "/bfmtLevels");
			Out.ar(0, 0); // Silent output
		}).play(server, nil, \addToTail);

			{

					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);

				}

	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
```

```supercollider
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// Create monitoring synth for buses 8-11 (B-format channels)
		monitorSynth = SynthDef(\bfmtMonitor, {
			var bfmt = In.ar(8, 4); // Read from buses 8-11
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, "/bfmtLevels");
			Out.ar(0, 0); // Silent output
		}).play(server, nil, \addToTail);
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { monitorSynth.free; OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

Updating B-format metering to read directly from the synth instead of audio buses:


```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 12 output channels (8 for decoded + 4 for B-format metering)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 12;

s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			// Send B-format levels for metering
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, '/bfmtLevels');
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) only - B-format metering reads from synth directly
			Out.ar(0, dec);
		}).add;

		s.sync;

	// Load test file automatically (4-channel UHJ: L, R, T=0, Q=0)
	buf = Buffer.read(s, "/home/michael-uwins/Dropbox/PhD/Practical Work/The Alan Parsons Project/Stereotomy/StereotomyUPHJ.wav");
	s.sync;

	// UI
	win = Window("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test", Rect(80, 80, 780, 380), false).front;
	win.view.background = Color.black;
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 10, 200, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test");
	fileLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(10, 35, 380, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("StereotomyUPHJ.wav (4-ch UHJ)");
	playBtn = Button(win, Rect(10, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["PLAY", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({
		if(buf.notNil && buf.numFrames > 0) {
			if(player.notNil) { player.free };
			player = Synth(\foa_512_test, [
				\buffer, buf,
				\muteWBus, muteBusses[0].index,
				\muteXBus, muteBusses[1].index,
				\muteYBus, muteBusses[2].index,
				\muteZBus, muteBusses[3].index
			]);
			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts
			{
				if(meter.notNil) { meter.remove };
				if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
				meter = ServerMeter2View.new(s, meterContainer, 0@0, 0, 8); // 0 inputs, 8 outputs (decoded)
				// Create custom B-format meter (monitors buses 8-11)
				bfmtMeter = ~createBFmtMeter.value(s, bfmtMeterContainer);
			}.defer(0.1);
		};
	});
	stopBtn = Button(win, Rect(100, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["STOP", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({ if(player.notNil) { player.free } });
	
	// B-format mute buttons
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 95, 100, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("B-format mutes:");
	muteBtns = Array.fill(4, { |i|
		var x = 10 + (i * 60);
		var label = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"][i];
		StaticText(win, Rect(x, 115, 20, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_(label);
		Button(win, Rect(x, 135, 50, 20))
			.states_([["MUTE", Color.black, Color.cyan], ["MUTE", Color.cyan, Color.black]])
			.action_({ |btn| muteBusses[i].set(btn.value) });
	});
	
	// Z amplitude monitor (to verify encoder fix)
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");
	
	// Monitor Z amplitude
	OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor, { |msg|
		var amp = msg[3];
		{
			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// Create monitoring synth for buses 8-11 (B-format channels)
		monitorSynth = SynthDef(\bfmtMonitor, {
			var bfmt = In.ar(8, 4); // Read from buses 8-11
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, "/bfmtLevels");
			Out.ar(0, 0); // Silent output
		}).play(server, nil, \addToTail);
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { monitorSynth.free; OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {

		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
```

```supercollider
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)

				.backColor_(Color.black)

				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { monitorSynth.free; OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
```

```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 12 output channels (8 for decoded + 4 for B-format metering)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 12;

s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			// Send B-format levels for metering
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, '/bfmtLevels');
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) only - B-format metering reads from synth directly
			Out.ar(0, dec);
		}).add;

		s.sync;

	// Load test file automatically (4-channel UHJ: L, R, T=0, Q=0)
	buf = Buffer.read(s, "/home/michael-uwins/Dropbox/PhD/Practical Work/The Alan Parsons Project/Stereotomy/StereotomyUPHJ.wav");
	s.sync;

	// UI
	win = Window("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test", Rect(80, 80, 780, 380), false).front;
	win.view.background = Color.black;
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 10, 200, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test");
	fileLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(10, 35, 380, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("StereotomyUPHJ.wav (4-ch UHJ)");
	playBtn = Button(win, Rect(10, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["PLAY", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({
		if(buf.notNil && buf.numFrames > 0) {
			if(player.notNil) { player.free };
			player = Synth(\foa_512_test, [
				\buffer, buf,
				\muteWBus, muteBusses[0].index,
				\muteXBus, muteBusses[1].index,
				\muteYBus, muteBusses[2].index,
				\muteZBus, muteBusses[3].index
			]);
			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts
			{
				if(meter.notNil) { meter.remove };
				if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
				meter = ServerMeter2View.new(s, meterContainer, 0@0, 0, 8); // 0 inputs, 8 outputs (decoded)
				// Create custom B-format meter (monitors buses 8-11)
				bfmtMeter = ~createBFmtMeter.value(s, bfmtMeterContainer);
			}.defer(0.1);
		};
	});
	stopBtn = Button(win, Rect(100, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["STOP", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({ if(player.notNil) { player.free } });
	
	// B-format mute buttons
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 95, 100, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("B-format mutes:");
	muteBtns = Array.fill(4, { |i|
		var x = 10 + (i * 60);
		var label = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"][i];
		StaticText(win, Rect(x, 115, 20, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_(label);
		Button(win, Rect(x, 135, 50, 20))
			.states_([["MUTE", Color.black, Color.cyan], ["MUTE", Color.cyan, Color.black]])
			.action_({ |btn| muteBusses[i].set(btn.value) });
	});
	
	// Z amplitude monitor (to verify encoder fix)
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");
	
	// Monitor Z amplitude
	OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor, { |msg|
		var amp = msg[3];
		{
			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 8 output channels (decoded only - B-format metering uses SendPeakRMS)

s.waitForBoot({

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			// Send B-format levels for metering
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, '/bfmtLevels');
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) only - B-format metering reads from synth directly
			Out.ar(0, dec);
		}).add;

			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 8 output channels (decoded only - B-format metering uses SendPeakRMS)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 8;

s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			// Send B-format levels for metering
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, '/bfmtLevels');
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) only - B-format metering reads from synth directly
			Out.ar(0, dec);
		}).add;

		s.sync;

			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts

			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 8 output channels (decoded only - B-format metering uses SendPeakRMS)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 8;

s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			// Send B-format levels for metering
			SendPeakRMS.kr(bfmt, 10, 3, '/bfmtLevels');
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) only - B-format metering reads from synth directly
			Out.ar(0, dec);
		}).add;

		s.sync;
```

```supercollider
	// Load test file automatically (4-channel UHJ: L, R, T=0, Q=0)
	buf = Buffer.read(s, "/home/michael-uwins/Dropbox/PhD/Practical Work/The Alan Parsons Project/Stereotomy/StereotomyUPHJ.wav");
	s.sync;

	// UI
	win = Window("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test", Rect(80, 80, 780, 380), false).front;
	win.view.background = Color.black;
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 10, 200, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test");
	fileLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(10, 35, 380, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("StereotomyUPHJ.wav (4-ch UHJ)");
	playBtn = Button(win, Rect(10, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["PLAY", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({
		if(buf.notNil && buf.numFrames > 0) {
			if(player.notNil) { player.free };
			player = Synth(\foa_512_test, [
				\buffer, buf,
				\muteWBus, muteBusses[0].index,
				\muteXBus, muteBusses[1].index,
				\muteYBus, muteBusses[2].index,
				\muteZBus, muteBusses[3].index
			]);
			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts
			{
				if(meter.notNil) { meter.remove };
				if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
				meter = ServerMeter2View.new(s, meterContainer, 0@0, 0, 8); // 0 inputs, 8 outputs (decoded)
				// Create custom B-format meter (monitors buses 8-11)
				bfmtMeter = ~createBFmtMeter.value(s, bfmtMeterContainer);
			}.defer(0.1);
		};
	});
	stopBtn = Button(win, Rect(100, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["STOP", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({ if(player.notNil) { player.free } });
	
	// B-format mute buttons
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 95, 100, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("B-format mutes:");
	muteBtns = Array.fill(4, { |i|
		var x = 10 + (i * 60);
		var label = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"][i];
		StaticText(win, Rect(x, 115, 20, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_(label);
		Button(win, Rect(x, 135, 50, 20))
			.states_([["MUTE", Color.black, Color.cyan], ["MUTE", Color.cyan, Color.black]])
			.action_({ |btn| muteBusses[i].set(btn.value) });
	});
	
	// Z amplitude monitor (to verify encoder fix)
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");
	
	// Monitor Z amplitude
	OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor, { |msg|
		var amp = msg[3];
		{
			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));

			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))

				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)

		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
```

```supercollider
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// B-format meters (W, X, Y, Z)
	bfmtMeterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 100)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("B-FORMAT METERS (W, X, Y, Z)");
	
	// Create B-format meter indicators and monitoring synth
	~createBFmtMeter = { |server, parent|
		var meters, monitorSynth;
		var meterWidth = 20;
		var gapWidth = 2.5;
		var labels = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"];
		
		meters = Array.fill(4, { |i|
			var x = 10 + (i * (meterWidth + gapWidth));
			var comp = CompositeView(parent, Rect(x, 25, meterWidth, 180));
			StaticText(comp, Rect(0, 165, meterWidth, 15))
				.font_(Font("Helvetica", 9).boldVariant)
				.align_(\center)
				.stringColor_(Color.cyan)
				.string_(labels[i]);
			LevelIndicator(comp, Rect(0, 0, meterWidth, 180))
				.warning_(0.6)
				.critical_(0.9)
				.style_(\led)
				.numSteps_(10)
				.stepWidth_(4)
				.meterColor_(Color.cyan)
				.backColor_(Color.black)
				.drawsPeak_(true)
				.numTicks_(10)
				.numMajorTicks_(0)
				.warningColor_(Color.new(0.86,0.54,0.04,1))
				.criticalColor_(Color.red);
		});
		
		// No separate monitoring synth needed - B-format levels sent from main synth
		monitorSynth = nil;
		
		// Create OSC responder for B-format levels
		OSCdef(\bfmtLevels, { |msg|
			{
				try {
					var channelCount = min((msg.size - 3) / 2, 4);
					channelCount.do { |channel|
						var baseIndex = 3 + (2 * channel);
						var peakLevel = msg.at(baseIndex);
						var rmsValue = msg.at(baseIndex + 1);
						var meter = meters.at(channel);
						if(meter.notNil && { meter.isClosed.not }) {
							meter.peakLevel = peakLevel.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1, \min);
							meter.value = rmsValue.ampdb.linlin(-80, 0, 0, 1);
						}
					}
				} { |error|
					if(error.isKindOf(PrimitiveFailedError).not) { error.throw }
				}
			}.defer;
		}, '/bfmtLevels', server.addr).fix;
		
		// Return object with cleanup method
		(remove: { OSCdef(\bfmtLevels).free })
	};
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(380, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(380, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
// FOA→5.1.2 decoder test (minimal)
// - Load 4-channel UHJ WAV → encode PHJ → FOA → decode 5.1.2
// - ServerMeter for outputs (8 channels)

// Configure server for 8 output channels (decoded only - B-format metering uses SendPeakRMS)
s.options.numOutputBusChannels = 8;

s.waitForBoot({
		var cond = Condition.new;
		var win, player, buf;
		var fileLabel, playBtn, stopBtn;
		var encoder, decoder;
		var meterContainer, meter;
		var bfmtMeterContainer, bfmtMeter;
		var muteBtns, muteBusses;
		var zAmpLabel;

		// Create PHJ encoder and 5.1.2 decoder
		encoder = FoaEncoderKernel.newPHJ;
		decoder = FoaDecoderMatrix.new5_2(\equal, 45, \uhjpi);
		// Decoder outputs: [C, FL, RL, RR, FR, TFR, TFL] (ATK order, 7 channels)

		// Control busses for W, X, Y, Z mutes
		muteBusses = Array.fill(4, { Bus.control(s, 1) });
		muteBusses.do(_.set(0)); // Start unmuted

		s.sync;

		// SynthDef for UHJ → 5.1.2 (encoder and decoder captured from outer scope)
		SynthDef(\foa_512_test, { |buffer, muteWBus=0, muteXBus=0, muteYBus=0, muteZBus=0|
			var stereo, bfmt, dec, lfe;
			var muteControls;
			// Height channel calculation variables (all var declarations at top)
			var el, az, g1, norm, distElevScalar, xScalar, yScalar, distCoef, z;
			var tflW, tflX, tflY, tflZ, tfrW, tfrX, tfrY, tfrZ;

			// Load file - 4-channel UHJ (L, R, T=0, Q=0) for PHJ encoder
			// If kernels are correct (as confirmed in Reaper), L/R with T=0,Q=0 should produce Z=0
			var fileChans = PlayBuf.ar(4, buffer, BufRateScale.kr(buffer), loop: 1); // Full PHJ (L,R,T,Q)
			bfmt = FoaEncode.ar(fileChans, encoder);
			// Apply mutes to B-format components (read from control busses)
			muteControls = [In.kr(muteWBus, 1), In.kr(muteXBus, 1), In.kr(muteYBus, 1), In.kr(muteZBus, 1)];
			bfmt = [bfmt[0] * (1 - muteControls[0]), bfmt[1] * (1 - muteControls[1]), 
			        bfmt[2] * (1 - muteControls[2]), bfmt[3] * (1 - muteControls[3])];
			
			// DEBUG: Check Z amplitude (for UHJ input, should be ~0 if encoder fix is working)
			// Send Z amplitude to control bus for monitoring
			SendReply.kr(Impulse.kr(10), '/zAmp', [Amplitude.kr(bfmt[3], 0.01, 0.1)]);
			
			// Decode using FoaDecode (matrix decoder)
			dec = FoaDecode.ar(bfmt, decoder);
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z
			// Scalars derived from elevation: accounts for angular distance from horizontal
			el = 45.degrad; // elevation angle (from decoder parameter)
			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)
			g1 = 2.sqrt; // √2 (first-order gain)
			norm = 0.577348; // normalization factor (from JSFX)
			// Distance/elevation scalar: cos(elevation) accounts for projection from horizontal
			distElevScalar = el.cos;
			// X scalar: scales with elevation (decreases as elevation increases)
			xScalar = g1 * el.cos * az.cos * norm;
			// Y scalar: maintain horizontal separation (constant, matches front speakers)
			yScalar = 0.34; // Constant (speakers maintain left/right position regardless of elevation)
			// W distance coefficient (normalized omnidirectional)
			distCoef = 0.408248; // 1/√6 (constant)
			
			z = bfmt[3] + DC.ar(0); // Z signal (ensure audio-rate)
			
			// Height channels: only output when Z is present (UHJ has Z=0, so height should be silent)
			// TFL: left height channel
			tflW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tflX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tflY = bfmt[2] * (-0.34) * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (negative for left)
			tflZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[6] = tflW + tflX + tflY + tflZ; // TFL
			
			// TFR: right height channel
			tfrW = bfmt[0] * distCoef * distElevScalar * z; // W scaled by distance/elevation and Z
			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]
			dec[5] = tfrW + tfrX + tfrY + tfrZ; // TFR
			
			// LFE from FL+FR lowpass (dec[1]=FL, dec[4]=FR)
			lfe = BLowPass.ar(dec[1] + dec[4], 120, 1, 0.4);
			// Reorder to 8 channels: FL,FR,C,RL,RR,LFE,TFR,TFL
			dec = [dec[1], dec[4], dec[0], dec[2], dec[3], lfe, dec[5], dec[6]];
			// Output decoded channels (0-7) only - B-format metering reads from synth directly
			Out.ar(0, dec);
		}).add;

		s.sync;

	// Load test file automatically (4-channel UHJ: L, R, T=0, Q=0)
	buf = Buffer.read(s, "/home/michael-uwins/Dropbox/PhD/Practical Work/The Alan Parsons Project/Stereotomy/StereotomyUPHJ.wav");
	s.sync;

	// UI
	win = Window("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test", Rect(80, 80, 780, 380), false).front;
	win.view.background = Color.black;
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 10, 200, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("PHJ → 5.1.2 Decoder Test");
	fileLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(10, 35, 380, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("StereotomyUPHJ.wav (4-ch UHJ)");
	playBtn = Button(win, Rect(10, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["PLAY", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({
		if(buf.notNil && buf.numFrames > 0) {
			if(player.notNil) { player.free };
			player = Synth(\foa_512_test, [
				\buffer, buf,
				\muteWBus, muteBusses[0].index,
				\muteXBus, muteBusses[1].index,
				\muteYBus, muteBusses[2].index,
				\muteZBus, muteBusses[3].index
			]);
			// Create/update ServerMeters after synth starts
			{
				if(meter.notNil) { meter.remove };
				if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
				meter = ServerMeter2View.new(s, meterContainer, 0@0, 0, 8); // 0 inputs, 8 outputs (decoded)
				// Create custom B-format meter (monitors buses 8-11)
				bfmtMeter = ~createBFmtMeter.value(s, bfmtMeterContainer);
			}.defer(0.1);
		};
	});
	stopBtn = Button(win, Rect(100, 60, 80, 24)).states_([["STOP", Color.cyan, Color.black]]).action_({ if(player.notNil) { player.free } });
	
	// B-format mute buttons
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 95, 100, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("B-format mutes:");
	muteBtns = Array.fill(4, { |i|
		var x = 10 + (i * 60);
		var label = ["W", "X", "Y", "Z"][i];
		StaticText(win, Rect(x, 115, 20, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_(label);
		Button(win, Rect(x, 135, 50, 20))
			.states_([["MUTE", Color.black, Color.cyan], ["MUTE", Color.cyan, Color.black]])
			.action_({ |btn| muteBusses[i].set(btn.value) });
	});
	
	// Z amplitude monitor (to verify encoder fix)
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");
	
	// Monitor Z amplitude
	OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor, { |msg|
		var amp = msg[3];
		{
			zAmpLabel.string = if(amp > 0.001, {
				"⚠️ %.4f (should be ~0)".format(amp.round(0.0001))
			}, {
				"✓ %.6f (correct)".format(amp.round(0.000001))
			});
			zAmpLabel.stringColor = if(amp > 0.001, { Color.red }, { Color.green });
		}.defer;
	}, '/zAmp');
	
	// ServerMeter container for decoded outputs
```
```supercollider
	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
});
```

```supercollider
			// new5_2 outputs 7 channels: [0]=C, [1]=FL, [2]=RL, [3]=RR, [4]=FR, [5]=TFR, [6]=TFL
			
			// Height channels: Z-scaled periphonic decode (matches user formula)
			// TFL = W*dist*Z + X*0.435*scalar*Z + Y*0.34*scalar*Z + Z

			az = 30.degrad; // azimuth angle (±30° for left/right)

			tfrX = bfmt[1] * 0.435 * xScalar * z; // X scaled by elevation scalar and Z
			tfrY = bfmt[2] * 0.34 * yScalar * z; // Y scaled by Z (positive for right)
			tfrZ = z * g1 * el.sin; // Z component (scales with elevation: √2 * sin(elevation)) - use z not bfmt[3]

	});

	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 160, 200, 18)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).string_("Z Channel Amplitude:");
	zAmpLabel = StaticText(win, Rect(220, 160, 150, 18)).stringColor_(Color.yellow).string_("--");

			}, {

	meterContainer = View(win, Rect(10, 185, 360, 180)).background_(Color.black);
	StaticText(win, Rect(10, 175, 360, 20)).stringColor_(Color.cyan).align_(\center).string_("OUTPUT METERS (FL, FR, C, RL, RR, LFE, TFR, TFL)");

	win.onClose = {
		OSCdef(\zAmpMonitor).free;
		if(bfmtMeter.notNil) { bfmtMeter.remove };
		if(player.notNil) { player.free };
		if(buf.notNil) { buf.free };
	};
```
